about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a Systems Engineer from Argentina with 7+ years building software — from interfaces to infrastructure. I lived and worked in Australia, which added a global perspective and distributed-team experience; my professional path was also built in Argentina and through remote work across different markets. I'm currently studying Protected Crops and Controlled Environments at UNLP, bridging technology and production in controlled settings. I'm comfortable with React, Next.js, Supabase and PostgreSQL, but what matters most is understanding the problem before picking the tool.
